scope: LLM token, cost, provider-attempt, and concurrency telemetry engine with global and per-provider rate caps, fallback chains, budget warnings/stops, and privacy-preserving LLMTelemetryDashboard UI component.

acceptance.token_cost_provenance: PASS; records provider/model, latency, prompt/output token counts, and estimated cost provenance ($0 for local/ollama).
acceptance.attempt_chains_and_fallbacks: PASS; records full attempt chains with error codes and fallback reasons when primary providers fail or rate-limit.
acceptance.concurrency_and_rate_caps: PASS; thread-safe global and per-provider concurrency slots enforced via acquire_slot context manager with AIConcurrencyLimitError.
acceptance.budget_controls: PASS; budget ceilings enforced with automatic warning thresholds and hard stops via AIBudgetExceededError.
acceptance.privacy_assurance: PASS; zero prompt text, user profile facts, or candidate PII stored in telemetry records.
acceptance.frontend_components: PASS; LLMTelemetryDashboard renders cost dials, token breakdown, concurrency saturation meters, provider error rates, task rollups, and attempt logs.
acceptance.safety: PASS; external submission OFF asserted; no external calls or unauthorized background daemons.

checks.target: Unit tests for token cost calculations, attempt records, fallback chains, concurrency, and budget ceilings
Multi-threaded concurrency, rate cap saturation, and privacy verification tests
TypeScript check and Vite production client build
